title: Harden the POC
brief: Three independent hardening changes that can run at once.

subIssues.title: Validate numeric settings at startup
subIssues.brief: In poc/hg/config.py the numeric settings (HG_QUIZ_SIZE, HG_PASS_FRACTION, HG_COOLDOWN_MINUTES, HG_MAX_ATTEMPTS, HG_SECONDS_PER_QUESTION, HG_GATE_SYNC_SECONDS) are parsed with int()/float() and never checked. Validate them where they are read: QUIZ_SIZE >= 1, 0 < PASS_FRACTION <= 1, COOLDOWN_MINUTES >= 0, MAX_ATTEMPTS >= 1, SECONDS_PER_QUESTION >= 10, GATE_SYNC_SECONDS >= 5. On a bad value raise SystemExit with a one-line message naming the variable, the value and the allowed range. Keep the module importable and reloadable. Add poc/tests/test_config.py covering one good reload and two bad values.

subIssues.title: Cache pip in the CI workflow
subIssues.brief: In .github/workflows/tests.yml, add `cache: pip` and `cache-dependency-path: poc/requirements.txt` to the actions/setup-python@v5 step. Change nothing else.

subIssues.title: Index the tables the parent page reads by night
subIssues.brief: poc/hg/db.py creates the SQLite tables in SCHEMA but no indexes. Add `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` statements for events(night), quizzes(night), assignments(night), tutor_messages(assignment_id), guard_events(assignment_id). Add poc/tests/test_db.py asserting those five indexes exist in sqlite_master. Don't change any table.

title: Document the hardening
brief: After the hardening task lands: one sentence in the README.

subIssues.title: README: settings are validated at startup
subIssues.brief: poc/README.md documents the settings in a table under '## Settings (environment variables)'. Add one sentence right under that heading saying the numeric settings are validated at startup and the server exits with a clear message on a bad value (read config.py on this branch to describe it accurately). Touch nothing else.
